name: 1Password
about: Watches 1Password's USA/Global region, where CMiC's account (cmicglobal.1password.com) is; an outage can block the team from reaching saved passwords.
details: Reads 1Password's status page and keeps only the USA/Global region. During an outage, team members may not be able to sign in, sync or open shared vaults.
label: :key: *1Password Status*
